summary: Merged the seven draft front-answer-leak content branches into one candidate review queue branch.
Refreshed twelve scoped audit reports to the combined queue corpus fingerprint.
Updated linked agent self-review quality_audit summaries for the twelve linked scoped reports.
Recorded the evidence boundary for PR #47: the residual four-card multi-prefix closure is backed by scoped audit and git handoff evidence, not by a normal 3-card-per-box agent self-review record.

Follow-up strict spot-check repaired 001208-001210: removed a legacy long-press instruction from a flip card, replaced template-like analysis with lost-plosive evidence, and normalized candidate TTS metadata to TTS_AI_generated.

After PR #52 made task_schema guide text part of visible front-leak auditing, repaired 000201-000202 by removing direct answer tokens from success_criteria and refreshed the 0002 scoped audit evidence.

After PR #53 made correct-option example text auditable, repaired 121204 by removing reduce from visible success_criteria and repaired 020207 by removing the v-ing answer clue from the front prompt while preserving back-side explanation and answer logic.
After PR #54 made answer semantic glosses auditable, repaired 120009 by removing the visible occurrence-probability gloss from success_criteria while preserving the back-side probability explanation.

After PR #55 made adjective answer semantic glosses auditable, repaired 022102 and 022104 by removing evidence-strength and practicality glosses from visible front guide text while preserving options, answers, and back-side explanations.

After PR #56 made research account-for semantic glosses auditable, repaired 020210 by removing the visible variable-control gloss from the front prompt while preserving options, answer, and back-side explanation.

After PR #57 made short preposition answer text and preposition semantic-role guide text auditable, repaired 022008, 022010, 022202, 022204, 022206, 022210, 022302, 022304, 022306, 022308, 022310, and 022410; the six older direct-answer cards also received card-specific analysis and missing candidate-only quality_metadata.

After PR #58 made front-side analysis-conclusion wording auditable, repaired 020008 by replacing “破解答案的关键” guide text with a task prompt that asks the learner to judge the noun by begin/continue compatibility.
After PR #59 made quoted clue-key wording auditable, repaired 020210 by replacing the visible “___ for 是关键” guide text with a substitution-and-collocation task prompt.
Kept the queue candidate-only: no reviews/approved_batches records and no committed global report refreshes.

2026-05-24 strict residual spot-check repaired 010006, 050112, and 150112: visible fronts now ask for locator/word-form strategy rather than exposing the exact correct option content outside the option list.

Refreshed thirteen scoped audit reports and linked agent self-review quality_audit summaries to corpus_digest=2240db804c67c9ba89befcf5705213ccc206ee29ed58f88d01264db74c7436b2; no global reports or approved_batches records are part of this candidate queue update.

review_evidence_boundaries.scope: CET4 banked cloze 0202 visible option-example front leak closure
review_evidence_boundaries.reason: PR #53 made correct-option example text part of visible front-leak auditing. 020207 exposed the correct option's v-ing clue in the front prompt outside the option list, so the prompt now asks for sentence-function and collocation judgment without naming the answer form.
review_evidence_boundaries.follow_up: Residual closure evidence only; user confirmation is still required before any approval or formal content merge.

review_evidence_boundaries.scope: CET4 banked cloze 0202 research account-for semantic-gloss front leak closure
review_evidence_boundaries.reason: PR #56 made research account-for semantic glosses mechanically visible to front-leak auditing, and PR #59 made quoted clue-key wording mechanically visible as an analysis-conclusion leak. 020210 exposed the correct option's variable-control meaning and later still labeled “___ for” as the key in the front prompt, so the prompt now asks for substitution, collocation, and research-limitation judgment without naming the semantic answer or declaring the decisive clue.
review_evidence_boundaries.follow_up: Residual closure evidence only; user confirmation is still required before any approval or formal content merge.

review_evidence_boundaries.scope: CET4 banked cloze preposition/direct-answer front leak closure
review_evidence_boundaries.reason: PR #57 made short preposition answer text and preposition semantic-role guide text mechanically visible to front-leak auditing. The affected cards either named the correct short answer in the front prompt or exposed the semantic role that selected the correct preposition, so the front prompts and visible task_schema guide text were rewritten without changing option keys or answer keys. Six legacy direct-answer cards also had repeated/template analysis in the audited scope, so their analysis was rewritten to card-specific explanations.
review_evidence_boundaries.follow_up: Residual closure evidence only; user confirmation is still required before any approval or formal content merge.

review_evidence_boundaries.scope: CET4 banked cloze 0200 analysis-conclusion front leak closure
review_evidence_boundaries.reason: PR #58 made front-side analysis-conclusion wording mechanically visible to quality auditing. 020008 exposed the conclusion that the relative clause was the key to cracking the answer; the front now keeps the sentence and required learner action while moving the conclusion back to the analysis side.
review_evidence_boundaries.follow_up: Candidate sample evidence only; user confirmation is still required before any approval or formal content merge.

review_evidence_boundaries.reason: Strict queue audit after the current harness found three remaining front-answer leaks: 010006 repeated answer-bearing locator text in the passage, while 050112 and 150112 exposed the full correct rewrite as the visible option target. The repair converts each front into a structure/strategy choice while keeping the answer key and back-side explanation boundary explicit.
review_evidence_boundaries.follow_up: Residual closure evidence only; this is not a 3-card-per-box sample approval and does not authorize formal content merge.
